name: Cocoro Planet
source:
The heart of a person is an infinite universe. Whether it's fictional or a wish.

Connect and tie to make a bond!

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]

人的內心，是無限的宇宙。無論那是虛構，還是願望。

彼此相連，緊緊相系，結成羈絆吧！
